# Encrypted compatibility fixtures

These five small PDFs exercise the Standard Security Handler revisions 2–6:

- RC4 with 40-bit and 128-bit keys;
- AES-128 with object-specific keys;
- AES-256 revisions 5 and 6.

They were generated by `generate_encrypted_fixtures.py` with pypdf 6.10.0 and
ReportLab 4.4.9, then opened independently with Poppler command-line tools.
The generators are not runtime or build dependencies of Poppler.Net.

`verify_encrypted_fixtures.py` checks every manifest hash and independently
recovers the expected metadata, text and attachment bytes.

The files use user password `user-03` and owner password `owner-03`. The user
permission mask allows printing, copying and accessibility extraction while
denying modification, annotations, forms and document assembly.

Four AES-128 variants additionally cover different `StrF`/`StmF` selections,
an independent `EFF`, an explicit stream `/Crypt` filter and the
`EncryptMetadata false` file-key branch.
